nodes.title: Aba-Seq
nodes.scope: Illumina single-route explanatory schematic for bulk AbaSI-coupled 5hmC mapping, interpreted with the supplied Sun et al. primary full text (PMID 23352666). It depicts glucosylation, AbaSI cleavage, biotinylated end-adaptor ligation, fragmentation and streptavidin capture, ending at DNA. Primary-supported library completion and readout are explicit interfaces, not claimed visible substeps. Catalogue-named scAba-seq and the distinct PvuRts1I related method are assessed separately at the supplied abstract evidence level; their detailed library architectures are not merged into this route.

original.label: Hydroxymethylated genomic DNA
features: The biological target is 5-hydroxymethylcytosine (5hmC) in DNA, drawn as red dots; the far-left highlighted-residue icon is explanatory, with no separate material-transfer arrow.
The primary implementation uses mouse E14 embryonic stem-cell genomic DNA; the schematic itself does not specify a specimen or a single-cell compartment.

original.label: AbaSI
original.description: Acts on glucosylated genomic DNA and generates double-stranded breaks near recognized 5gmC, yielding the separated duplex fragments drawn after the arrow.
